question: After the pacing bug is fixed, should ambiguous outbound entries without reconciliation-capable adapters remain pending/backed off instead of becoming terminal failed entries?
rationale: The PR intentionally trades clearer fail-closed operator state for future recoverability of ambiguous sends, and tests cannot decide that product/operations policy.

options.title: Accept Recoverable Pending
options.body: Merge after the no-op pacing fix if maintainers want ambiguous no-adapter rows to remain recoverable until adapter reconciliation exists.

options.title: Keep Fail-Closed State
options.body: Close or pause this PR if maintainers prefer current main's terminal failed behavior until the full delivery ledger is designed.

options.title: Require Operator Surface First
options.body: Ask for a visible doctor, UI, or API path before allowing ambiguous rows to stay pending longer.

recommendation.title: Accept Recoverable Pending
recommendation.body: Merge after the no-op pacing fix if maintainers want ambiguous no-adapter rows to remain recoverable until adapter reconciliation exists.

likelyOwner.reason: This choice crosses the recent recovery rewrites he merged/co-authored and the operator-facing queue-state policy.
